classes.umkm_reserved_coextensive: Lampiran II dialokasikan row coextensive with the KBLI-2025 code on its own text (no qualifying parent, no qualifier or narrower text, single reserved ancestry, title ≈ row text) — or, ONE explicit exception (13133, `closure_basis`), narrower on its own text with the remainder closed by a Lampiran III 100%-domestic row so that the union covers the code — allocated to Koperasi/UMKM (Pasal 5(1)(a)); a PMA is Usaha Besar (Pasal 7(1)) → not available. classes.umkm_reserved_located_scope_review: canonical closes the whole 2025 code but the Lampiran II row is either PROVEN narrower on its own text (qualifying parent / in-row qualifier / narrower product) or of UNRESOLVED coverage (merged non-reserved ancestry, plausible split heir) — NOT counted as sourced-closed; review
classes.umkm_kemitraan_no_bar: row ticked under KEMITRAAN on the annex page — duty to partner, not a bar
classes.umkm_reserved_whole_row: Lampiran II dialokasikan row naming the code without a qualifier, catalogue publishes it open, coverage UNRESOLVED (readable cell that enumerates products under a generic title, a 2025-widened title, or merged non-reserved ancestry) — candidate closure, per-row reading for the owner (Pasal 5(5)); NOT counted
classes.umkm_reserved_segment: only the named Bidang Usaha inside the KBLI is reserved (Pasal 5(5)) — qualifying parent, in-row qualifier, narrower product, or a plausible split-heir overlap; the code stays open otherwise
classes.umkm_reserved_crosswalk_projection: a Lampiran II row reaching a 2025 code only through the KBLI-2020→2025 split, where the heir's title is DISJOINT from the named activity — no demonstrated overlap, nothing reserved here, nothing to apply
classes.foreign_cap_0: Lampiran III 'Modal dalam negeri 100%' on a bidang usaha coextensive with the KBLI → a new PT PMA cannot be established (press/broadcasting rows: establishment only, expansion routes in `condition`)
classes.foreign_cap_0_crosswalk_projection: a 0% row reaching a 2025 code only through the mechanical KBLI-2020→2025 crosswalk, where the 2025 activity is arguably outside the instrument's scope — verify, never apply
classes.foreign_cap_0_segment: Lampiran III 'Modal dalam negeri 100%' on a bidang usaha NARROWER than the KBLI (Pasal 6(3)) — the segment is closed to PMA, the code is not
classes.foreign_cap_pct: Lampiran III foreign share capped (49%) as the ORDINARY limit: PMA as minority; entry #7 (defence) admits >49% with Menteri Pertahanan approval — see `condition`
classes.foreign_cap_ambiguous: same KBLI-2020 code carries different caps per Bidang Usaha
classes.conditional_other_requirement: Pasal 6(3a) alcohol trade — conditional, neither closed nor capped
classes.sector_law: closure living in a sector statute, not in the Perpres annexes (press/broadcasting: establishment only, expansion route in `condition`; notaris: public office of a WNI natural person — entity-form closure)
classes.sector_law_person_restriction: sector statute restricts the professional PERSON (advokat asing, UU 18/2003 Pasal 23), the ownership/entity-form rule for the activity is not sourced — NOT counted as a capital closure, NOT a finding that PMA ownership is permitted
classes.residual_open_besar_row_absent: open by default (Pasal 3(1)(d)+(2)) — codes on a Lampiran II row are excluded (3(1)(d) is residual to 3(1)(b)); no Besar row in the PP 28/2025 Lampiran I — Permen 5/2025 Pasal 8(6): a missing scale alone is not a closure; the licensing pathway is a declared gap
